title: npm client reaches the network through a cleartext proxy
description: .npmrc declares a proxy URL that uses cleartext http. The proxy sees every request in the clear, including authenticated registry calls, so a hostile or shared proxy can read and rewrite traffic.
remediation: Use an https proxy, or terminate TLS at a proxy that presents its own verified certificate.
limitation: It matches a proxy URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
